decisions.reason: Confirmed defect. Netlist evidence places R1 (10k, per saved schematic value) directly between /IN and /OUT; with /IN held at 48 V and /OUT externally clamped to 0 V, R1 dissipates 48^2/10000 = 0.2304 W continuously, 2.304x the declared 0.1 W continuous limit in inputs/requirements.txt. C1 carries no DC current and does not reduce R1 dissipation. The optimist-a counter-figure of 0.002304 W equals 48^2/1e6 (a 1 Mohm assumption or 100x arithmetic error) and contradicts the saved 10k value, so it is rejected.
